description: This file contains implementation of network link classes (OneWayLink and SymmetricLink) used in a QUIC protocol simulation, including methods for packet acceptance, scheduling, and random delay handling.

classes.name: OneWayLink
classes.description: Represents a unidirectional network link with packet queuing, delay, and scheduling.

classes.name: SymmetricLink
classes.description: Represents a bidirectional network link composed of two OneWayLinks.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the link, schedules its transmission based on bandwidth and delay.

methods.name: TimeUntilAvailable
methods.description: Returns the time remaining until the link is available for a new packet.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Processes the next packet in transit, delivering it to the sink.

methods.name: ScheduleNextPacketDeparture
methods.description: Schedules the departure time for the next packet.

methods.name: GetRandomDelay
methods.description: Calculates a random delay to simulate network noise, bounded to prevent out-of-order delivery.
